about.title: About us
about.description: We are part of AGESCI, the Italian Catholic Guides and Scouts Association. We support girls and boys aged 8 to 21 through the scout method: outdoor activities, community life and service to others.
about.leaders: Our unit leaders are volunteer educators trained by the association. We meet at the parish of Cristo Re in Padova.

path.title: From 8 to 21 years old
path.intro: The scout journey has three stages. Each has its own unit, leaders and way of experiencing adventure.

pack.description: Cub scouts discover games, outdoor life and their first responsibilities together.

troop.title: Scout troop (Reparto)
troop.description: Scouts and guides work in patrols, taking on projects, camps and scout skills.

clan.description: Rovers and rangers choose a path of hiking, community and service.
